caption:
does whey protein cause acne?

Probably not on its own. In a six-month trial of 49 young men, whey didn't make acne worse.

Do you take whey? Yes or no below.

It was a randomized non-inferiority trial: the men, all with acne, took either 30 g of whey a day or a supplement without whey. The whey group's acne didn't get worse than the other group's, on the face or the back and chest.

The idea that whey causes breakouts came mostly from case reports (a few gym-goers whose acne flared after starting shakes) and an observational study that found more whey users among people with acne. Those can point to a link, but they can't show cause. It's also one small trial, so it isn't the last word.

If your acne started the same month as the shakes, test it yourself: pause them for four weeks and compare in the mirror.

Send this to your gym buddy who blames his protein.

General education only. If your acne is painful, scarring or not improving, see a doctor in person.
